reason: In Gick & Holyoak (1983), Experiment 5 (p. 26, Table 7A), the key comparison of producing the convergence solution before the hint between the with-principle condition (62%, 45/73) and the without-principle condition (40%, 28/70) is tested using a maximum-likelihood chi-square test reported as G2(1) = 6.75, p < .01 (exact p = 0.009375). The shipped value (0.01548195) is not from the original paper; it was recalculated in Boyce et al. (2023) using a Yates-corrected Pearson chi-square test on the 2x2 counts (45/73 vs. 28/70, X2(1) = 5.8608, p = 0.01548195). The blind extraction correctly captures the original paper's reported p-value (< .01).
